test_title: PYST 28: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 4 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2' **i.e.** 'Fighting'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The sentence states** that they were in the same unit, indicating that they were actively involved in fighting or participating in battles together.
 
• Therefore, the** correct form** to use is the present participle form, **"fighting," **which describes an ongoing action.
 
• **It matches **the tense and context of the sentence.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *There were two **childhood** buddies who went through school and college and even joined the army together. War **broke out** and they were **fighting** in the same unit. One night they were ambushed. Bullets were flying (4)________and out of the darkness came a voice, “Harry, please come and help me”. Harry (5)________recognised that voice of his childhood buddy*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1, "fought," **is the past tense form and does not convey the continuous action required in this context.
 
• **Option 3, "fight,"** is the base form and does not capture the ongoing nature of their involvement in the unit.
 
• **Option 4, "fights,"** is the present tense form, but it does not agree with the subject-verb agreement in the sentence.
